purpose: Plan a future controlled write layer without enabling any real write in this package.

writePlanningScope.name: Allowed write candidates
writePlanningScope.description: Define which future write candidates may be considered after QA and manual approval.

writePlanningScope.name: Write target boundaries
writePlanningScope.description: Define exact targets; Data Model write remains blocked until future approved package.

writePlanningScope.name: Rollback requirement
writePlanningScope.description: Every future real write must have a rollback plan.

writePlanningScope.name: Manual approval requirement
writePlanningScope.description: No real write may occur without explicit manual approval.

writePlanningScope.name: Audit requirement
writePlanningScope.description: Pre-write and post-write audit gates are mandatory before and after any future real write.

safetyRules: This package does not enable real write.
DELETE remains only DELETE_CANDIDATE and cannot execute.
Every future write requires rollback plan.
Every future write requires dry run and QA.
Every future write requires manual approval.
System Audit must remain secure before write planning continues.
blockedActions: perform real write in planning layer
mutate Data Model in planning layer
manualTestInstructions: Find block: Controlled Write Planning Layer v1.
If any real write is allowed — stop and roll back to 166D.
nextStep: Prepare PACKAGE 168D — Controlled Write Plan QA Gate v1.
